established.objective_scope: The 60 binary terminal-direction targets do not cover the full M5 Entry path/MAE/MFE/FLAT objective. This scope limitation does not by itself explain weak direction discrimination.

interpretation: Weak five-minute discrimination appears on TRAIN, including late presentation groups; calendar aggregation does not hide a strong descriptive Q1 month in these seven variants.
This is not a formal rejection of forgetting or proof that raw inputs contain no signal.
Longer-horizon TRAIN ranking is stronger than short-horizon ranking, but useful future direction is unqualified.

Initial zero price projection versus ordinary GC initialization is a source-proven asymmetry. Terminal weight norms and separately measured weak activation support inspecting this integration, not a proven causal fix.
Input availability/range shifts are real. They cannot alone explain weak TRAIN ranking; some older output-subgroup measurements have different feature-view/model identity.
Matched two-pass and10x five-minute-weight results do not qualify more identical training as a solution.

prioritized_proposals.proposal: Make the four-field native price-projection initialization explicit; consider existing ordinary Linear initialization instead of the current zero residual, with RNG isolation and fresh function identity.
prioritized_proposals.basis: Intentional zero initialization preserves the predecessor function. Exact initial zeros and small trained price activation motivate a distinct initialization hypothesis, not a proven bug or causal fix; no invented multiplier or blanket feature removal.
prioritized_proposals.validation_required: Any actual constructor/forward/training requires the user to lift the current prohibition. Preserve own fresh baseline, all other inputs/masks/targets and predetermined full-population comparisons; improved activation alone is insufficient.

prioritized_proposals.proposal: Design native GC price-relative coordinates using the existing source/unit/anchor contract, including all relevant native timeframes, preserved masks/anchor/basis and measured numeric roundtrip error.
prioritized_proposals.basis: Absolute price range and history-availability shift across the chronological split; snapshot implementation already exists but is not a proven native fix.
prioritized_proposals.validation_required: Explicit native field/unit mapping and TRAIN-only normalization; no changing the scoring population or introducing future anchors. Evaluate separately from initialization after distinct authorization.

not_recommended_as_untried_solutions: Repeating the already-complete narrow momentum-zeroing or unseen-GC-field-zeroing interventions
unknown: Information potentially recoverable from genuine inputs before encoding
Causal effect of alternative initialization or native price coordinates
Current-function convergence and transient learning/forgetting history
Independent prospective directional or economic edge

review.norm_caveat: GC matrices contain more coordinates; Frobenius ratios alone are not activation-strength ratios. Use the separate actual activation audit for amplitude claims.
review.final_source_review: Passed after correcting the momentum-profile owner path and replacing learned ranking with measured ranking in the horizon comparison. No causal improvement or edge is claimed.
